shared_elements: schematic face or mask-like motifs with eyes and mouth-like forms
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces include schematic, glyph-like relief/incised motifs, including face-like forms with eyes and oval or circular details, organized at least partly in vertical groupings. The major difference is that A is essentially a dense rectangular grid of many small signs, while B is dominated by one large frontal anthropomorphic or body-like figure with only a few subsidiary signs on it.
